top_signal.title: Need recommendations for a new credit card processor
top_signal.summary: Small professional office. Generally do about 5 to 12 charges a day. Most transactions are in the mid or higher three figures. many clients have mileage type or other specialty cards, and the card is usually presented at the time of the charge although a couple of times a week, we may take a payment over the phone. We accept everything from Visa to AMEX to Discover. Our current processor has our money available the next business day and we would like to keep that. we rarely need to call customer service.   Suggestions, please for the lowest cost option thank you       submitted by     /u/Clueless5001       [link]       [comments]
